label: F40 Cloudreach the_high_perches High|Medium
brief: Fixed production-camera views of one Cloudreach location (the high perches) across times of day and weather, with the 1.80 m trainer as a ruler. Judge whether it reads as the key art's Cloudreach sky realm: a coherent place of layered floating land, readable landmarks and light that belongs to the world.
defects: Flat magenta slabs or rings on the ground
Placeholder or untextured materials (flat grey, checker or faceted blocks)
Floating bodies or props (a gap between an object and the ground under it)
Clipping (geometry passing through geometry, or the camera inside geometry)
